chunks.title: İLBANK (İller Bankası — Türkiye Municipal Development Bank) (İLBANK) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: İLBANK (İller Bankası — Türkiye Municipal Development Bank) is a National Development Bank headquartered in Türkiye. At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Signed municipal climate finance advisory agreement with EIB & City Climate Finance Gap Fund on Nov 13 at COP31. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: EIB & City Climate Finance Gap Fund advisory partnership for low-carbon, climate-resilient municipal urban infrastructure across Türkiye. Source verification: https://news.europawire.eu/eib-and-ilbank-launch-advisory-partnership-to-advance-climate-resilient-urban-investment-in-turkiye/eu-press-release/2026/11/13/17/05/05/187788/.

chunks.title: İLBANK Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: İLBANK (İller Bankası — Türkiye Municipal Development Bank) provides the following climate financing instruments: Municipal Infrastructure Loan, MDB On-Lending Credit, Technical Assistance (Gap Fund), Resilient Urban Grant Co-Financing. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 1,000,000 to USD 150,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Municipality, Sovereign/Government, Municipal Utility.

chunks.title: İLBANK Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by İLBANK (İller Bankası — Türkiye Municipal Development Bank): Resilient Cities & Infrastructure, Water & Wastewater Management, Urban Mobility & Transport, Renewable Energy, Zero Waste & Circular Economy. Target geographic focus includes: Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: İLBANK Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete İLBANK's application form: Turkish municipality or municipal utility applicant status; Municipal council borrowing resolution & Treasury debt limit compliance; EIB / City Climate Finance Gap Fund climate resilience appraisal; Environmental Impact Assessment (ÇED) & feasibility study. Explicit exclusion rules: Private non-municipal commercial projects; Fossil-fuel infrastructure. Official application portal: https://www.ilbank.gov.tr/.

chunks.title: İLBANK Form Template: Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form
chunks.text: İLBANK (İller Bankası — Türkiye Municipal Development Bank) uses the 'Development Finance Institution (DFI) / National Dev Bank Project Intake Form' workflow governed by IFC Performance Standards / Harmonized DFI Climate Reporting (10by30 / IDFC). Typical review timeline is 4–12 weeks (Screening -> Due Diligence -> Credit Committee). Form sections required: 1. Sponsor Profile, 2. Transaction Structure, 3. Climate & Impact, 4. Financial Due Diligence, 5. Risk Assessment, 6. Executive Summary.
